title: Coin Change
statement: You are given coins of different denominations and a total amount of money `amount`. Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount. If it is impossible, return `-1`. You may use each coin as many times as you want.
followUp: What is Coin Change II counting combinations?
editorial: dp[x] = min coins to make x. dp[0]=0, else inf. For each coin, update amounts upward.
